summary: Lewis Hamilton faces a critical redemption moment at Austin as Kimi Antonelli arrives on the brink of clinching the world championship, with Ferrari seeking to capitalize on Mercedes' Singapore miscalculation. McLaren's midfield charge collides with Red Bull's desperate push to salvage points in a constructors' battle that hinges on tire management in Texas's grueling heat. An Antonelli victory would seal Ferrari's first drivers' championship in a decade, fundamentally reshaping the season's narrative after Hamilton's strategic misstep handed the momentum entirely to the Scuderia.
